items.title: Gordon Lorraine — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Paul, by accident, although he’s played at the club forever... He never wanted to go out of town any more. He was very happy to be in New York... He gave a lot to the club.

ctx.x: You have special relationships with musicians. For example, somebody that we all respect, and that’s Paul Motian. Can you talk about Paul?

Oh, yeah. You can’t help it. You fall in love with certain musicians. I’m not talking about amorous love. I’m talking about your respect for each other. And Paul... I can’t get over to this day that he just left me so fast. I didn’t even know he was ill. Well, I knew he had... Everybody’s got something bugging them. But he went so fast. In a way, I’m glad that he didn’t suffer forever. I really am, for that alone. But he was very important to me. Paul, by accident, although he’s played at the club forever, since...
